name: pt9-imperial-nothing-to-score
description: Soak pbd672 / pbd746 (pt9 rollback): Imperial's holder met no public objective and End Turn was refused forever ('finish Imperial: score a public'). Imperial scores a public objective only IF ABLE, so (bot pt9-followups, StrategyCardResolveKind.able) a conditional mandatory part binds only while it can be done: here Yssaril (pbd28@89, round 1) meets neither revealed public, so after the secret draw End Turn is accepted without pressing Score A Public; before the secret it is still refused.
